correctness.rationale: The edge-labeled overlap graph has every weight-one vertex of degree two and every zero/two vertex degree one. Forced-path contraction gives a balanced two-arc directed graph on m=n-2 vertices with arcs i->i-1 mod m and i->m-1-i (loops and parallel arcs distinct). Euler cycles anchored by the unique 0^(n-2)1 edge are counted by in-arborescences via BEST, since all outdegrees two. The Fourier blocks of 2I-P-R have paired determinants 2(1-zeta^k)(1-zeta^-k) and exceptional eigenvalue four for even m; directed tree cofactor equals 2^floor(m/2). Independently constructed all contracted integer cofactors for m=1..15 and directly enumerated binary rotation classes for n=3..6: 1,2,2,4. Rotational anchoring is essential.
